channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLhealthAndWellness, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Italy sees wider, longer West Nile spread as Europe warms
item.description: Italian health authorities cite evidence that rising temperatures and longer warm seasons are helping mosquitoes spread West Nile virus across a wider area.

item.title: West African scientists warn of weakening health systems, urge stronger outbreak detection
item.description: West African laboratory scientists called on governments Friday to strengthen capacity to detect disease outbreaks to avoid another major outbreak.

item.title: Non-opioid pain management gets separate pay in 2026
item.description: As the third-highest opioid-prescribing medical specialty representing 6 to 8 percent of all U.S. opioid prescriptions, orthopedic surgeons carry an outsize role.

item.title: Florida confirms dengue death amid one of its worst recent outbreaks
item.description: Florida is experiencing one of its worst surges of dengue fever in decades, and the toll now includes a death.
